text_block_list.text:
The URA Finals came to a close with 
tremendous success. However, that wasn't 
the only thing that happened—
<chrname> was crowned the first Finals Champion!

<chrname>'s presence hyped up the tournament, and 
Chairwoman Akikawa was greatly satisfied.

<chrname>'s presence hyped up the tournament 
greatly and drove the crowd wild.

To celebrate the massive success of the 
URA Finals, Chairwoman Akikawa prepared a 
banquet—

And with that, she received a folding fan 
and heaps of high praise.

Tucking the gifted folding fan securely 
inside, <chrname> and I vowed to continue living up 
to Chairwoman Akikawa's passionate 
feelings!
